raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`python -m sglang.multimodal_gen.tools.build_minimax_h3_pdd_weights` merges an Acc-8Step (PDD) LoRA from `alibaba-pai/MiniMax-H3-Acc-LoRAs` into the native MiniMax-H3 transformer. The LoRA is trained on the Diffusers SwiGLU projection (`ff.net.0.proj`), whose rows are `[value, gate]`. The native fused `mlp.fc1` is `[gate, value]`: the Diffusers checkpoint loader in `models/dits/minimax_h3.py` swaps the same halves when it loads `ff.net.0.proj`, and the tool already re-lays out `to_q` / `to_k` / `to_v` for `qkv_proj`. For fc1 it adds the delta unswapped, so in every block the gate rows receive the value delta and the value rows the gate delta. The merged Acc8 model then generates soft, blurry video.

## Modifications

- `tools/build_minimax_h3_pdd_weights.py`: `_diffusers_to_native_fc1` swaps the two halves of the fc1 delta before the merge. Every other target is unchanged.
- `test/unit/test_minimax_h3_pdd_offline.py`: `test_fc1_delta_is_merged_into_native_gate_value_rows` merges a one-block fc1 LoRA into a zero base and checks that the gate half lands on the native gate rows. It fails on the current `main` and passes with the fix; the other cases in the file pass either way.

Acc8 weights built with the current tool need to be rebuilt.

## Accuracy Tests

Weights: the FL2VA transformer merged with `MiniMax-H3-FL2VA-Acc-8Step.safetensors`, once with the current tool and once with this fix. Against the base weights plus the LoRA delta in the native layout (computed in FP32, rounded to BF16), the fixed merge matches all 258 merged tensors bit for bit. The current tool's output differs only in the 52 `mlp.fc1` tensors (5.2e9 elements, worst tensor error 12.7x the BF16 rounding of the reference). The 277 non-target tensors are identical in both.

Video: MiniMax-H3 FL2VA Acc8, t2va 768p 16:9, 15 s (362 frames), 9 sigma points, flow shift 12 / 3, seed 42, transformer attention `torch_cudnn_sdpa`, SGLang v0.5.21 (this tool is identical in v0.5.21 and `main`). The two runs of each prompt differ only in the transformer weights and their fused PDD heads. With the current tool, outlines of faces, eyes and hair are soft and smeared and flat areas look washed out; with the fix the same frames have sharp line art and detail.

| Prompt | Laplacian variance, current tool | Laplacian variance, with the fix |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 2D-animated character close-up | 190.6 | 427.1 |
| Live-action scene with a 2D-animated character | 399.1 | 631.2 |

Mean over 61 evenly spaced frames of the decoded RGB; higher is sharper.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not affected: the change runs once in the offline weight-merge tool.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

This is a small fix to the offline MiniMax-H3 Acc LoRA merge tool: the fc1 delta was merged in the Diffusers [value, gate] row order instead of the native [gate, value]. The new regression case in `test_minimax_h3_pdd_offline.py` fails on `main` and passes with the fix. CI needs the `run-ci` label (or `/tag-and-rerun-ci`) to start. Thanks!
LGTM once the diffusion unit CI passes.

files.patch:
@@ -201,6 +201,37 @@ def test_conversion_keeps_heads_outside_transformer(self):
                 index,
             )
 
+    def test_fc1_delta_is_merged_into_native_gate_value_rows(self):
+        """The LoRA's fc1 delta comes in the Diffusers [value, gate] row order; merged
+        unswapped, the gate delta lands on the native value rows and vice versa."""
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
+            root = Path(temp)
+            base = root / "base"
+            base.mkdir()
+            weight_name = "blocks.0.mlp.fc1.weight"
+            save_file({weight_name: torch.zeros(4, 3)}, str(base / "model.safetensors"))
+            lora_up = torch.arange(4, dtype=torch.float32).reshape(4, 1)
+            lora_down = torch.ones(1, 3)
+            lora = {
+                "transformer_blocks.0.ff.net.0.proj.lora_down": lora_down,
+                "transformer_blocks.0.ff.net.0.proj.lora_up": lora_up,
+            }
+            for key, value in _make_heads().items():
+                lora[
+                    key.replace("video_out", "proj_out").replace(
+                        "audio_out", "audio_proj_out"
+                    )
+                ] = value
+            lora_path = root / "lora.safetensors"
+            save_file(lora, str(lora_path), metadata={"lora_rank": "1"})
+            out = root / "out"
+            build.main([str(base), str(lora_path), str(out)])
+            value, gate = (lora_up @ lora_down).chunk(2)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                load_file(str(out / "transformer" / "model.safetensors"))[weight_name],
+                torch.cat((gate, value)),
+            )
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main(verbosity=3)

@@ -37,6 +37,13 @@ def _interleave_qkv(q: torch.Tensor, k: torch.Tensor, v: torch.Tensor) -> torch.
     ).reshape(-1, in_dim)
 
 
+def _diffusers_to_native_fc1(delta: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Diffusers SwiGLU [value, gate] rows -> the native fused fc1 [gate, value] layout,
+    the same swap as the Diffusers checkpoint loader in models/dits/minimax_h3.py."""
+    value, gate = delta.chunk(2, dim=0)
+    return torch.cat((gate, value), dim=0)
+
+
 def _target_of(lora_key: str) -> str | None:
     """LoRA module name -> official weight name. None means "not handled here"."""
     k = lora_key
@@ -99,6 +106,8 @@ def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
         target = _target_of(module)
         if target is None:
             raise SystemExit(f"no mapping rule for {module}")
+        if target.endswith(".mlp.fc1"):
+            delta = _diffusers_to_native_fc1(delta)
         for role in ("to_q", "to_k", "to_v"):
             if target.endswith(f".attn.{role}"):
                 qkv.setdefault(target[: -len(f".attn.{role}")], {})[role[-1]] = delta
